alias.title: Command alias
alias.markdownDescription: It should be a short name, and the full name should be in `name`

then.errorMessage: If spaces are needed, please use " or ' to wrap them, for example: 'hello world'

tip.markdownDescription:
Completion item description (shown as the `[Description]` section).
- The `usage` and `example` fields hold the usage/example lines separately.
- Here is an example:
```json
  "tip": [
    "Add file changes to the index."
  ]
  ```

allOf.errorMessage: Each item in the array will automatically add a line break at the end when displayed, so line breaks are not allowed.

items.errorMessage: Chinese and English must be separated by a space

repeat.description: Maximum number of times this item can repeat.

usage.markdownDescription:
Completion item usage lines (shown as the `[Usage]` section).
- Optional; if absent, no usage section is shown.
- Each item is a plain string, or an object `{ "cmd": ..., "desc": ... }` — in object form **both** `cmd` and `desc` are required (use a plain string when there is no explanation).
- Example:
```json
  "usage": ["-r, --revisions <REVSETS>", { "cmd": "add|install <APP>", "desc": "install a package" }]
```

oneOf.errorMessage: Chinese and English must be separated by a space

example.markdownDescription:
Completion item example lines (shown as the `[Example]` section).
- Optional; if absent, no example section is shown.
- Each item is a plain string, or an object `{ "cmd": ..., "desc": ... }` — in object form **both** `cmd` and `desc` are required (use a plain string when there is no explanation).
- Example:
```json
  "example": ["-r '@-'", { "cmd": "d demo.zip *.bak -r", "desc": "delete all .bak files" }]
```

oneOf.errorMessage: Chinese and English must be separated by a space

next.markdownDescription:
Next subcommand completion (**commands only**)
- Must be a **non-empty array** — a subcommand either has a next level (its subcommands) or none at all.
- A command's parameter value (if any) is expressed by the `usage` placeholder, never by `next`.
- Items in the array are automatically added to the completions.

next-for-option.markdownDescription:
Next completion for an **option** (candidate values)
- Must be an **array**.
- A **non-empty** array lists static candidate values (selecting one records it as the option's `value`; an out-of-list word is `unknown`). The symbol is `switch`.
- An **empty** array `[]` means "no static candidates" — hooks may supply dynamic items and set the symbol via `psc.set_symbol`; otherwise the value is typed manually and is `unknown`.

option.markdownDescription:
Next optional completion
 - Usually starts with `-` or `--`
 - For example, `--list`

meta.description: Additional information for the completion command

url.description: Homepage or repository address of the completion command

allOf.errorMessage: It must be a valid http/https URL
Each item in the array will automatically add a line break at the end when displayed, so line breaks are not allowed.

items.errorMessage: Chinese and English must be separated by a space

next.description: Subcommand completion for the root command

option.markdownDescription: Optional completion for the root command

global_option.markdownDescription:
Global optional completion
- Any time you trigger completion, they will be displayed
- Unless you have used it or its alias

config.description: Special configuration items for the completion command

name.description: Name of the special configuration item

value.description: Default value of the special configuration item

values.markdownDescription:
Optional values of the special configuration item
- Here, you can fill in the values that will be displayed when the command completion is triggered
 - Suppose the command completion is `xxx` and the configuration item name is `enable_xxx`
 - Then, when you input `psc completion xxx enable_xxx` and trigger completion, the values in the `values` array will be displayed in the completion list

tip.description: Tip information for the special configuration item

info.markdownDescription: Additional information, exposed to hooks via `psc.manifest.info`
